description: This file defines the UnitConverterResults class, which provides methods to retrieve and verify the display of conversion results in a UI test framework for a calculator application. It interacts with UI elements via Selenium WebDriver and performs text processing and assertions.

classes.name: UnitConverterResults
classes.description: A class providing methods to access and verify calculation result UI elements in the calculator test framework.

methods.name: GetCalculationResult1Text
methods.description: Retrieves the text from the first calculation result UI element, removing non-numeric characters.

methods.name: IsResultsDisplayPresent
methods.description: Asserts that both calculation result UI elements are present (not null).

methods.name: GetCalculationResult2Text
methods.description: Retrieves the text from the second calculation result UI element, removing non-numeric characters.
